title: Your Unique Trigger
description: If my name were a trigger� what would it do to you? I don't want you to even have a mind at all. I want you to get fucked up on being lost and controlled by my voice. This file is designed to be simple, effective, and intense. Multiple layers - whispers, mantras, binaurals - building pressure, creating heat. Sensory overload so you brain gets too lost in my voice to form a thought at all. The goal of this file is to turn my name � Lamb � into a trigger. But what reaction it triggers is entirely up to you. It�s designed to give you a personal, internal response - your own unique trigger. You might be able to enjoy this file to it's full potential if you know what you would like my name to trigger in you prior to listening. This file works best with repeated listening, and is especially suited for those who already have a sense of what they want my name to evoke prior to listening. This file is intentionally open-ended and layered for intensity. With minimal safeties and an abrupt wakener, it�s best suited for listeners who understand and actively practice subject agency.
